crossRefs.note: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you…
His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gad
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of Jehovah.
